title: City of Light cocktail
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 ounce orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier or Cointreau)
ldInstructionsRaw: Fill a small pitcher halfway with ice. Add vermouth, Lillet, and orange liqueur, and stir briskly until well-chilled. Strain into a stemmed wine glass.
Add a generous handful of fresh ice and top with a pour of Prosecco. Drop in a lemon and orange wheel, and serve.
